inputs.label: Your installed Killzone HD folder (NPUA80856, version 01.00, from the Killzone Trilogy disc or the PlayStation Store): the folder with PARAM.SFO and USRDIR, as your PS3 or RPCS3 installed it.
Optional: your decrypted EBOOT.elf (19,706,080 bytes, SHA-256 c81aa91e35a76ff7d856095c392cee98bcc4b01879d7f13e5a389c6ee2d903fc). Leave it out when your RPCS3 has the game: it makes this copy itself.
